Implemented the dependency upgrade and source fixes.

Key changes:
- Updated Cargo manifests for the dependency group, including `smoltcp 0.11`, `image 0.25.1`, `windows 0.56`, `nix 0.28`, `env_logger 0.11`, and `data-encoding 2.6`.
- Restored the PR-era `Cargo.lock` resolution to avoid newer transitive crates requiring Edition 2024, which Cargo 1.75 cannot parse.
- Adapted smoltcp/image API changes in ICMP, TCP routing, UDP, and Windows icon encoding code.
- Added a crate-local smoltcp compatibility alias in [src/lib.rs](/app/src/lib.rs) and [src/wire.rs](/app/src/wire.rs) so the upgraded smoltcp API works without modifying test files.

Verification:
- `cargo test --workspace --locked` passes.
